word: He wins a small award at school.
answer: Él gana un premio pequeño en la escuela.

word: We talk about his project on the way home.
answer: Hablamos de su proyecto camino a casa.

word: I try to help him carry his backpack.
answer: Intento ayudarlo a llevar su mochila.

word: They invite us to a study group later.
answer: Nos invitan a un grupo de estudio más tarde.

word: You wash the dishes after lunch.
answer: Lavas los trastes después de la comida.

word: Your sister cleans the living room.
I call my mom to check in.
answer: Llamo a mi mamá para saludarla.

word: Friends arrive with notebooks and snacks.
answer: Amigos llegan con cuadernos y botanas.

word: They carry extra pencils for everyone.
Later we are going to send the homework answers.
answer: Más tarde vamos a mandar las respuestas de la tarea.
